steps.name: Live preview card
steps.goal: Wait for the web project preview card. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The card names the Expo app, says the preview is live, and offers an open action.

steps.name: Expired Expo Go link
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My old app'. Only inspect it and do not tap anything. A 'Link expired' message on this card is the expected result of this test, not an error.
steps.done: The 'My old app' card says the Expo Go link expired and shows a 'Restart preview' button.
expect: The Expo Go link expired. Restart the preview to get a new one.

steps.name: Expo Go card, Expo signed in
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My todo app'. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The todo app card offers to open it in Expo Go and names the Expo account in a short 'as' caption.

steps.name: Expo not signed in
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My connect app'. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The 'My connect app' card offers 'Connect Expo' with one short line to sign in to preview on the iPhone.
expect: Sign in to preview on your iPhone
forbid: Sign in to Expo in the Computer window

steps.name: Stopped preview
steps.goal: Find the card for 'My sleeping app', the second card. Tap its 'Restart preview' button, the first 'Restart preview' on the screen, directly below 'The development server is not running. This happens when the Computer sleeps.' 'Stopped' and 'Link expired' on these test cards are expected results of this test, not errors.
steps.done: The stopped card says the agent was asked to restart the preview.
expect: The development server is not running. This happens when the Computer sleeps.
Asked the agent to restart it

steps.name: Connecting Expo
steps.goal: On the 'My connect app' card, tap 'Connect Expo' once. Do not tap 'Open in Expo Go' on any card.
steps.done: The 'My connect app' card asks to sign in to Expo in the Computer window and offers 'Open Computer' and 'Cancel'.
expect: Sign in to Expo in the Computer window…

steps.name: Cancel Expo sign-in
steps.goal: On the 'My connect app' card, tap 'Cancel' once.
steps.done: The card says the Expo sign-in was cancelled and offers 'Connect Expo' again.
forbid: Sign in to Expo in the Computer window…

steps.name: Web level first
steps.goal: Scroll down to the card for 'My web level app', the last card. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The 'My web level app' card shows the web preview inline, with icon tabs for Web and Your phone under it and a full screen button.

steps.name: Switch to Your phone
steps.goal: On the 'My web level app' card, tap the 'Your phone' tab once.
steps.done: The 'My web level app' card now shows an 'Open in Expo Go' button and the account caption.
